svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Know what enrollment means
Your Windows host · Notepad lab notes
External practice user
Firewall / private lab boundary
RHEL 9 DMZ application server
NGINX · TLS ends here
Hosted practice application
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
Your notes have a pretend approval entry: service, approved name, requester and date.
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. For a real enterprise request, follow the approved service owner, registration authority and CA
process. Keep its approval record and requested SANs.
2. For DoD PKI, use the current official PKI/PKE guidance and your organization’s PKI representative. We
do not provide a made-up enrollment website, approval chain or claim of DoD access.
3. In this lab, you act as the practice reviewer and approve only app.example.mil for your isolated
machine. Nothing is sent to a real DoD system.
4. PEM is text encoding with BEGIN and END markers. CRT and CER are filename conventions, not proof of
encoding; either can be PEM or DER. KEY conventionally identifies a key file. A CSR is a request, not an
issued certificate.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
